title: Keep rollout percentages valid
why: A literal rollout percentage outside zero through one hundred, or mutually exclusive percentages totaling above one hundred, cannot represent a valid allocation.
suggestion: Correct the literal percentages so each value is within range and mutually exclusive allocations total at most one hundred.
limitations: Only literal numeric percentage, allocationPercentage, and rolloutPercentage fields in recognized JSON feature registries are inspected.
Array totals are checked only when at least two object entries use explicit percentage fields; arbitrary weights and runtime targeting expressions are excluded.
